description: Realistic vehicle trajectories and driving parameters from CARLA autonomous driving simulator is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Nikos Piperigkos. This dataset contains realistic trajectories from multiple vehicles moving in the simulated environment of CARLA autonomous driving simulator. Two different maps (Map04 and Map10) have been exploited, corresponding to realistic driving conditions in simulated urban environments. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
